maintenance_led.reason: Sells new implantable heart valves (TAVR SAPIEN, surgical RESILIA valves) for first-time procedures, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Hospitals buy its valves; payment comes from mixed public and private insurers, not mostly government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through in-house valve innovation and clinical research; acquisitions are occasional, and it sold Critical Care to BD.

mission_critical.reason: Implanted heart valves need regulatory approval and surgeon training; clinical outcomes make switching costly and risky.

notes: Public funding is uncertain: Medicare covers many patients, but the payer mix is not shown on the site.
